summary: Banco BBVA Argentina S.A. filed a Form 6-K disclosing that the Central Bank of Argentina authorized a cash/in-kind profit distribution of ARS 69,011,025,123, payable in three monthly equal non-cumulative installments. The distribution follows an April 28, 2026 shareholder meeting resolution; the Board will set timing, terms, and conditions. This is a dividend distribution (capital return to shareholders) rather than a share repurchase or other special situation. As a foreign private issuer, the 6-K reports a material event. Watch for exact per-share amounts and any regulatory or currency constraints affecting payment.
